name: Phantom Jailer
description: A spirit appears and arrests the creature by clamping manacles around their wrists.
disable: DC 18 Athletics check to seize the manacles from the spirit, DC 19 Intimidation check (trained) to order the spirit to stand down, or DC 20 Occultism check to exorcise the spirit

offensiveAbilities.name: Capture
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature touches the manacles

Effect The spirit attempts to lock the manacles around the triggering creature's wrists. The triggering creature must attempt a DC 23 Reflex save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The spirit loosely places manacles around the creature's wrists. Removing the manacles requires a single action.

Failure The spirit clamps the manacles around the creature's wrists but fails to lock them. The creature is Off-Guard and Clumsy 1 until the manacles are removed as a 3-action activity.

Critical Failure The spirit clamps the manacles around the creature's wrists and locks them. The creature is off-guard and clumsy 1 until the manacles are removed (Escape DC 23, simple lock).
